snippet.title: IWA Retro Adventure - First DEV long gameplay.
snippet.description:
After 10 months of work, I am close to completing my first game! IWA Retro Adventure. I want to show you what Gameplay looks like at the final stage of the campaign. Look forward to more! Ask questions, send the link to the video further. Thank you in advance!
DISCORD iwa channel - https://discord.gg/cAYdWRu5sF
